tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// pad+ma rā ga'i ri bo'i lhun ni rnam pa sna tshogs rin chen gyis// rnam par brgyan pa nyi ma'i 'od kyis snang bar byas pa lta bu yi// sku dang rgyan dang kha dog mchog dang 'od zer 'bar bas nyer lham pa// dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dmar la btud de yi sgrub pa bdag gis bshad// dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pas 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dur khrod la sogs par stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i don du/ gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ lag pa g.yas bstan la reg la/ oṃ badz+ra ā sa ni hūm̐/ zhes pas stan rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab/ rang skad cig gis gshin rje gshed dmar por dmigs pa'i dpral bar pad+ma dang zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dang nyi ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa la hūm̐ sngon po bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdag nyid bsrung*/ snying gi nang du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po bsgoms pa las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i rigs bdag tu bla ma bzhugs pa spyan drang*/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang*/ na maḥshrī ya ma a ri maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs phyag 'tshal/ snying ga nas mchod rdzas rnams 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rim pa bzhin mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/

badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// la sogs pa'i sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum gsum du bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad pa/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa/ kun nas sems snyoms pa'i tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs par bsgoms pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ mum̐ las ri rab shar shel/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa bang rim bzhi dang*/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ phyogs bcur 'od zer 'phros pa las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar zhing nang dmar ba gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du/

pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ snod gyi 'jig rten thams cad yongs su sbyangs pa gzhal yas khang pa rnams su gyur te/ 'od slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ nag po'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ mda' yab kyis bskor ba'i 'og tu/ rin po che'i shar bu las/ drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ sgo bzhi'i thad so bzhir rta babs bzhi'i steng du pad+ma dang chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa'i steng du gdugs phub cing*/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng du/ lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing*/ rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres nas mdzes par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ 'og gi gzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can/ rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i lte ba dang*/ rwa dbus ma bzhir/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan bsam mo// gdan dbus ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dang mi mgos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ dpal gshin rje gshed du gyur/ slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed/ dpa' bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa/ phyag g.yon na bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thad pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas pa 'jig rten gsum rnam par 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po bzung nas gdengs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/

mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa cung zad bye zhing*/ drag por bzhad pa'i zhal ljags 'gyur bag can/ sku sbom zhing lto ba rgyas pa/ dbu skra dang*/ sma ra ser zhing 'bar ba/ bzhengs pa'i zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i mgo dang*/ g.yon brkyang pas tshang ra mnan pa/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu/ 'jog po dmar pos rna ba/ rigs ldan khro bos dpung pa/ dung skyong ser pos phyag gi mkhrig ma/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul pa/ stobs kyi rgyu ljang gus se ral kha/ nor rgyas dkar pos rked pa/ pad+ma chen po dkar pos zhabs kyi mkhrig ma rnams brgyan zhing*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis kyang spras pa/ mi'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma/ phyag g.yas pa gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs shing*/ g.yon thod pa gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thal chen gyi rgya spangs shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gzhan rnam pa dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das ji lta ba dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gnyis ka yang ye shes gyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bsgom par bya'o// de'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i shar du gti mug gshin rje dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'dzin zhing*/ tsartsi ka nag mos 'khyud pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'dzin zhing*/ phag mo ser mos 'khyud pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'dzin zhing*/ dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu ral gris mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'dzin zhing*/ gau rī ljang gus 'khyud pa/ phyag mtshan dang cha lugs gzhan rnams ni gtso bo yab yum dang 'dra ba'o// me'i mtshams su mu men gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ bden bral du gser gyi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba/

rlung du byu ru'i bum pa sih+las gang ba/ dbang ldan du dngul gyi bum pa ga bur gyis gang ba rnams kyi khar me tog dang 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i shing lo dang*/ bdud rtsis lngas gang ba'i thod pas brgyan par bsgom par bya'o// de nas lha rnams kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ snga ma bzhin mchod/ rang gi snying ga nas/ tho ba dang*/ be con dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gri 'dzin pa'i khro bo rnams spros te/ oṃ shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ oṃ mut+ka ra rak+ta ya ma a ri/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs dgug oṃ daṇ+ḍa ya ma a ri pra be sha ya hūm̐ gis gzhug pad+ma ya ma a ri ban+dha baṃ gyis dbyer med par gyur/ khaḍ+ga ya ma a ra ba shaṃ ku ru heḥs mnyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ dmigs nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta/ badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros pas/ rigs lnga yab yum la/ sems dpa' dang khro bo dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo du mas bskor ba spyan drangs/ snga ma ltar mchod nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis dang*/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/

dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pas/ yab rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ yum rnams la rang rang gi yab rnams kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas yum rnams kyi bha ga a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa dang*/ yab rnams kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse mo gcig par bskyed nas/ lha rnams mchod pa'i 'du shes kyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas phyi nang gi lha rnams mnyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa/ badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// yang snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pas/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams su gyur pa/ sbyor mtshams nas spros nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par bsgom zhing*/ sngags snga ma rnams brjod do// slar yang de dag gis/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje gshed dgyes 'jigs pa po// ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// sku yi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal 'dud// ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje gshed dgyes 'jigs pa po// sems kyi rdo rje ston mdzad pa// rin chen rdo rjer phyag 'tshal 'dud// 'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// 'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso// dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal 'dud// phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje gshed po las kun byed// sku yi rdo rje rab ston pa// phyag na ral grir phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod nas/ lha mo de dag rang gi thugs kar bstim ste/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de mnyam par gzhag go

/bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// de nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'khor 'das snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yum dang bcas pa/ gtso bo la bsdu/ de yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ de rim gyis nā da la bsdus te sems gzung ngo*// mthar nā da'ang yal nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /de goms pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur te/ 'od gsal ba bsgom pa'i tshul lo// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas 'od gsal las skad cig gis zung 'jug gi sku/ gshin rje gshed du bzhengs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor snod bcud dang bcas pa snga ma ltar gsal btab nas/ yab rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros nas/ yab yum gyi steng 'og gi sgo gnyis nas 'khor ba'i 'od kyi snang bas/ rang gi sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ hauṃ k+ṣauṃ/ k+ṣa yaṃ ka ra ya/ grih+na grih+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se na a dhi pa ta ye/ ma hā durdān+ta da ma kā ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ bi trā pa ya bi trā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phreng ba'i sngags so// oṃ dwe ṣa ra tī nu dra nu dra/ tru ṭa tru ṭa hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ rje btsun ma'i 'o// oṃ mo hān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pi shu nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā gān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ir+ṣ+yān+ta kri ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpa' bo bzhi'i 'o// oṃ mo ha ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ pi shu na ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ rā ga ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ ir+ṣ+ya ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma bzhi'i ste/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzlas pa ni bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas gtor ma gnyis bshams la/

hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du/ āḥlas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta/ nub byang du shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang shar du mam̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis kha bcad pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las dbyug to hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ des sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga shin tu bzhu nas/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar zhing tsha bar gyur/ rlangs pa dbyug to la phog pas/ de thur du lhung nas/ dkrugs te zhu ba las 'o ma ltar dkar zhing bsil bar gyur pa las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun du rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dmigs la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis grub pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs shing*/ oṃ shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bstim pa la/ gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ rak+ta mu ku ṭā ya/ rak+ta dza ṭā ya/ rak+ta mu khā ya/ rak+ta shā ri rā ya/ rak+ta bhu dzā ya/ rak+ta muṇ+ḍa mā la bha ra ṇā ya/ rak+ta ra tha sa ma ru ḍhā ya/ rak+ta pad+ma ā sa nā ya/ rak+tā bha ra ṇa bhu ṣa ṇā ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ grih+na grih+na/ ma ma bhigh+nān/ ha ra ha ra/ tsa turmā rā na/ ni bā ra ya ni bā ra ya/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ bh+ra ma ya bh+ra ma ya/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/

sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ts+tshe da ts+tshe da/ bhe da bhe da/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ mo ha ya ma a ri ye/ i maṃ ba liṃ/ grih+na grih+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ pi shun ya ma a ri ye/ i maṃ ba liṃ/ grih+na grih+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ rā ga ya ma a ri ye/ i maṃ ba liṃ grih+na grih+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ swā hā/ oṃ ir+ṣ+yā ya ma a ri ye/ i maṃ ba liṃ/ grih+na grih+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma rme ma rmā/ bi ghā te hūm̐/ badz+ra tsartsi ka ha ra ha ra/ suk+kaṃ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ a mu kaṃ dzaḥ oṃ gho ṇe su gho ṇe/ badz+ra ma ma ki bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ a mu kaṃ dzaḥ oṃ ma rme ma rmā/ k+ṣo bha ṇe/ badz+ra sa ra swa ti/ da ra da ra/ tha ra tha ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ka n+ya ka n+ya/ dhu na dhu na/ hūm̐ a mu kaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ gam+bhi re/ badz+ra karti ke gha gha hūm̐/ rak+ta sho ni ta pri ye/ gau ri ye a mu kaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ gti mug rdo rje la sogs pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab bo// gtor ma gnyis pa'ang snga ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba duṣ+ṭ+rān/ in+d+rā ya ā di na sa pa ri wā rā na ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug gi shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ steng du tshangs pa/ de'i g.yas su zla ba/ g.yon du nyi ma/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo/ de'i g.yas su lha ma yin thag zangs ris/ g.yon du khyab 'jug rnams 'khod par bsams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba rnams gshin rje gshed du gyur pa la gtor ma dbul bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ in+d+rā ya na maḥhrīḥ ya mā ya na maḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥ ba ru ṇā ya na maḥwi/ ku be rā ya na maḥkṛ/ ī sha nā ya nā maḥta/ ag+na ye na maḥ.a/ nai ṝ t+yā ya na maḥn/ wā ya be na maḥn/ tsan+d+rā ya na maḥhūm̐/ arkā ya na maḥhūm̐/ brah+ma ṇā ya na maḥphaṭa/ ba sun+dha rā yai na maḥphaṭa/ bai ma tsi trā ya na maḥswā/ sarba bhū te bh+yo na maḥhā/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ nongs par spyad pa bzod par gsol nas/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod nas mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gshin rje gshed du mos pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lces lus thams cad yongs su gang ba'i snying gar gshin rje gshed lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong bcu bzhi la 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis kyis dgang blugs kyi kha me'i sgor phul bas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad mnyes par bsam zhing bza' 'o// zas kyi lhag ma/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa piṇ+ḍa a si bh+yaḥswā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gti mug gshin rje gshed me long lta bu'i ye shes/ phra ma gshin rje gshed mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ tsartsi ka byams pa tshad med pa/ rdo rje phag mo snying rje tshad med pa/ dbyangs can ma dga' ba tshad med pa/

dkar mo btang snyoms tshad med pa/ thod pa dang bcas pa'i bum pa bzhi ni 'dod pa'i yon tan dag pa dga' ba bzhi dang*/ phrin las bzhi dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo'o// zhes lha'i dag pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ngo bo'o// zhes dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dran par byas nas/ snod bcud thams cad kyang de'i ngo bor blta'o// de nas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor yum dang bcas pa snying gar bsdus nas/ rang nyid gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi nga rgyal gyis gnas la/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha'i sku/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyis bsam pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du bsams te/ kun tu spyod pa thams cad lha mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du dmigs la kun tu spyad do// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang 'dra ba'o// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba dang mtshungs so// khrus ni dbang gi skabs dang 'dra zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya'o// las kyi tshogs sgrub pa'i tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ rnal 'byor de dag la rgyun mi chad par nan tan du byas na/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyis gnas skabs kyi don nye bar bsgrubs nas/ sa dang lam thams cad bgrod de/ mthar thug bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// 'di yi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka bī ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niṣ+ka laṅka de wa/ dpyal lo tsā ba/ slob dpon rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje/ 'phags pa rnams so// lung gi rjes 'brangs grub pa'i skyes bus rnam par sbyar ba'i gzhung gi don// man ngag dam pas rab tu brgyan pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'di 'phags pas sbyar// dge ba gang zhig nye bar bskrun pas bdag dang skye dgu thams cad kyis// srid zhi mthar byed gshin rje gshed dpal go 'phang dam pa thob par shog

/dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i gsal byed 'di ni/ dge slong sngags 'chang 'phags pas chu mo bya'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gcig gi snga dro'i cha la shing kun gyi mkhar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
